distribution_to_mainland.proposed: Controlled public viewing halls and relay distribution over mapped infrastructure, rather than an instant planet-wide broadcast assumed by fiat

years.coverage_heritage_proposal: Stone arena acoustics, live herald announcements, handwritten scores and post-event record sheets. No historical digital footage asserted.
years.production_operation: Small open recording desk; Crown Stair and Grove separated by marshalled couriers; Last Field witnessed directly.
years.permanent_architecture_note: Original stone lanes and two gates, simple flood/torch light; no invented arena screens.

years.coverage_heritage_proposal: A distinct announcer platform at each semifinal and formal carrying of certified result tablets. Audio/video apparatus not asserted.
years.production_operation: A small central records office schedules returns from both semifinal grounds; fans at the beach follow result boards.
years.permanent_architecture_note: Expanded bench and sheltered commentators' platform without replacing founding stone.

years.coverage_heritage_proposal: Six entrants and two quarterfinal stages motivate dedicated arena commentators and central bracket communications.
years.production_operation: Two opening venues, two semifinal venues, one final. Separate staff need a standardized dispatch shift and result ledger.
years.permanent_architecture_note: Quarry and Saltwind crowd separation; basic mobile communications proposal subject to technological timeline.

years.coverage_heritage_proposal: A 0.10-point quarterfinal margin elevates certified score verification, visual score captions in modern retrospectives, and in-world publicly legible final results.
years.production_operation: Scorekeepers preserve 114.37 and 114.27 exactly. No winner announcement before comparison.
years.permanent_architecture_note: Quarry boundary cameras belong to later recreations unless dated physical equipment is independently approved.

years.coverage_heritage_proposal: New Pro Schemin league signage, sponsor-style event hierarchy and consistent studio identity, with any in-world electronic camera infrastructure strictly conditional.
years.production_operation: Central coverage desk establishes standardized introductions and a dedicated Match of the Round highlight workflow.
years.permanent_architecture_note: Refurbished announcer stalls and a guarded island-wide public result corridor.

years.coverage_heritage_proposal: Where Mahomies at? wins by 0.75; close-result certification and carefully timed live commentary become the model for all later finales.
years.production_operation: The field announcer waits on written official sign-off. Contemporary retrospectives can add slow-motion reconstruction if labeled recreated.
years.permanent_architecture_note: Last Field upper gallery gains a separate records counter; avoid inventing instant-score displays in historical scenes.

years.coverage_heritage_proposal: Seven qualifiers and three first-round venues justify a centralized production HQ and independent arena crews. Island-specific electronic cameras/screens proposed; historic installation dates unverified.
years.production_operation: A triple-input production desk routes three simultaneous quarterfinal stories into a fixed central bracket show; one winner from each.
years.permanent_architecture_note: Broadcast HQ and service cables physically follow controlled routes, separated from spectator and contender movement.

years.coverage_heritage_proposal: Dedicated camera coverage and historical-context packages emphasize 13–1 Red Leopards' semifinal exit and 7–7 El Niño's championship.
years.production_operation: Replay only sourced match-state moments; public hosts distinguish a favorite's record from a guaranteed title.
years.permanent_architecture_note: The Crown Stair view of the beach descent becomes a recurring coverage cutaway.

years.coverage_heritage_proposal: Professional analyst introductions, season-by-season historical archive visualizations and high-capacity display proposals distinguish the sixth seed's championship path.
years.production_operation: Camera A isolates the two competitors; Camera B follows official checkpoints; control desk shows bracket-wide consequence after confirmation.
years.permanent_architecture_note: Significant hardware expansion on surviving stone must not hide unchanged historical archways.

years.coverage_heritage_proposal: Upper suites, modern live-screen installations and professional field reporting deliver an elite final-week production experience.
years.production_operation: Introduce 2024 ObiWan's verified QF/SF path, then the unchanged Last Field approach. Different paths to the final receive equal airtime.
years.permanent_architecture_note: Camera gantries, booth sightlines, hospitality/crowd separation and emergency lanes physically audited before release.

years.coverage_heritage_proposal: Multi-camera production, on-site jumbo screens, dedicated broadcast engineering and stable score feeds reflect the Founder desired modern 2026 baseline.
years.production_operation: Use 0.40-point Grove semifinal certification as the editorial standard. The Immortal's victory over ObiWan remains the primary title fact.
years.permanent_architecture_note: Preserve identifiable championship gates under contemporary displays and stage equipment.

current_2026.production_brief: One island broadcast headquarters, distinct venue crews per round, separate beach studio and championship memorial ceremony coverage
